payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the baselines used in the context of second language acquisition modeling, including logistic regression, GBDT, and RNN methods.

claims.text: The state-of-the-art baselines for SLA modeling include logistic regression (LR), gradient boosted decision trees (GBDT), and recurrent neural networks (RNN).
A new baseline combining GBDT and RNN was introduced, which is the best method in the 2018 public SLA modeling challenge.
The proposed method outperforms all existing baselines in low-resource scenarios.
